verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs say you can always export your notes into an open format such as HTML or Markdown. The founder repeats this on HN, explicitly as the answer to lock-in concerns. However, the export is documented only in a single sentence. Programmatic export is ruled out because the API cannot serve E2E-encrypted note contents. missing for 10: detail on whether the export covers all data (attachments/images, backlinks, note history), a documented step-by-step export procedure, independent hands-on confirmation of a complete export, an API-based bulk export path.
